But for unknown reason, my 《Blaze》 didn’t have a shape of a weapon but a protector, and it takes the form of a 《Shield》.

Kashiwada Naoki was determined to lead his high school life without anyone knowing that he’s an Otaku. However, his classmate Bishoujo, Koigasaki Momo, who was rumored among the girls to be a b*tch, found out about his secret!? 2216.synopsis:
The first time that I met him, all sultry, I frivolously advised him, “Young man, next time do not look so attractive. It is dangerous to wander around.”
The fourth time that I met him, I was wearing a high school uniform and carrying my school bag. I bowed to him respectfully and said “Uncle, you are so handsome. You will make a great match with my teacher. When both of you get married, I will be the flower girl, ok? ”
The fifth time that I met him, he chased me in the street until I got stuck in a dead end. His eyes slightly amused said, “Want to be my flower girl? You are twenty four years old, also want to be a flower girl?” I said: “Big Brother, don’t get too excited ah …” He replied: “Of course I am excited. Have you heard of the bride being the flower girl?”

2984.synopsis: Having lost his money, lover, and future, a man who has given up on everything finds himself reincarnated in the kingdom of Altodestenia. He, Lectival, has no memories prior to being saved by Meriela, the daughter of an aristocrat, and now finds himself rising up to save the kingdom in its current crisis.

4008.synopsis:
When Theodore was dropped into a waterway by his half-brother, he suddenly recalled the memory of his past life.
He had been a Japanese citizen known as Kirishima Kagehisa, placed inside VRMMO character he had made in Break Force Online.
‘Theodore’ is a Combat Mage that Kagehisa played within BFO, and he realized his skills were progressing well even in this other world.
Theodore, who had lightly brushed off his half-brother to make his own place in the world, had ventured off to the large labyrinth existing at the Boundary City, Termuilles, to find his own place in the world.
associated_names: Boundary Labyrinth and Magician of Alien World

4776.synopsis:
The story begins with Shen Miao having been married twice with two ex-husbands. If you think that the story will be old-fashion revolving around the rivalry and jealousy of the two ex-husbands, then you are wrong. The story is really sweet and funny, with many twists and turns in the plot . It turned out that the two ex-husbands are actually staging a play together with a motive.  Thus, Shen Miao who is clueless about it from beginning to end is in fact performing a monologue as no one gave her a script beforehand.
True feelings?
Fake feelings?
Who took advantage of her?
Who often protect her?
Who is willing to wait five years for her?
Who is willing to give up the throne for her?

6568.synopsis:
Li Yuan was struggling at the bottom of society, however out of the blue a peach pit appeared. He did not know that at that moment, the peach pit will completely transform his life.
With this peach pit, Li Yuan not only strengthened his body, but also changed normal crops to rare highest quality items.
Henceforth Li Yuan started to manage a farm, established a ranch and bought a fishing ground. Not only did he become the number one crop supplier, but also possessed a land to govern, making him a genuine landlord.
He had leisure time to enjoy beautiful landscapes, pleasantly touring the mysterious world, tasting top-notch culinary cuisine, effortlessly chatting with females, this beautiful life is no longer a dream!

8104.synopsis:
“With your own strength, prove the worth of your species.”
Without warning, every man, woman, and child was teleported off to fight an endless series of battles. Failure to clear every objective means that humanity shall be purged, or so the Operator claims.

8616.synopsis:
One day, a boy with the same name of Liu Maoxing from Chuuka Ichiban was transported to the world of “Shokugeki no Soma”….
For the sake of maintaining his ‘Tongue of God’, he has no other choice but to aim for the peak of the world of cooking!
As a chef at the level of “Instant noodle cooking”, Liu Maoxing has only his “Single-use Course” to help him through his difficulties while also helping him elevate his true cooking skills.
From golden fried rice, dream mapo tofu, persimmon with green pepper and pork stir fry….to century egg, jade phoenix dumplings and seabream continental map….. The menu of “Chuuka Ichiban” will make its reappearance in Tōtsuki Culinary Academy!

11432.synopsis:
What is the sun? What is light? What is time? What is existence?
In the dark vastness of the universe, what were robots created for in the end times, and for what did they perish?
Civilization, go and wander in the darkness, then blossom for love.

17832.synopsis:
High society CEO Big BOSS Lu expresses that he’s felt stifled recently. Ever since a woof style creature intruded upon his home, his life has become a complete mess. A slight conflict in opinion and his couch is hijacked, his desk seized, his lap forcefully occupied, even his bed was forcefully dominated!
The small Samoyed, with his head resting upon his waste removal official’s thigh and four paws facing the sky exposing a soft little belly, with a face full of untainted purity and a pair of innocent eyes: “Woof~”
Big BOSS Lu lowers his head and makes eye contact for three seconds : “…. Give give give! Whatever you want, I will give it to you!”

19112.synopsis:
Li Xiaobei, twenty-three years old, graduated from medical school for one year, interested in adventure, raising flowers, small animals, sloppy, a little lazy, Xiaobei likes romance, loves fantasy, every day except for the lottery, it is imagined on TV or like in the book, it’s more fun to go through the fun on an ancient adventure.

She always advocates equality between men and women and hates masculinity! 
But this is a female-dominated world, does it really exist? Is this a matriarchal society?

20136.synopsis:
He is the renowned playboy that terrifies the world, and countless people’s supreme king.
A night was turned upside down as she recklessly pushed him down on the bed, her face clear and cold: Remember, you’re bottom, I’m top!
“Offending me, aren’t you afraid I’ll kill you?”
“Not afraid. You wouldn’t. ”
Little by little pressing his bottom line, time by time declaring her sovereignty.
Shen Shenxue’s principle is: Even if the entire world spoiled him, she absolutely had to domesticate him into a loyal dog.
Quan Shi: There’s people who love your beautiful and alluring image, there’s people who love your rich spirit, and only I hate your never conceding stubbornness and your endless passionate, deep love.

22184.synopsis:
One day, wandering the streets, complaining of hunger, a cute boy runs to her and shouts, “Mama!”
The handsome Duke, the father of the child, offers a contract to provide food and lodging when she becomes a nanny.
Lina, the poor beggar, who suddenly had a son, finds out that the dead Duchess looks just like her…
 She tries to recall the lost memories of her past and surprisingly, it was connected to the Duke and the late Duchess.

22440.synopsis:
Xia Ning is betrayed by her boyfriend who wants to marry another girl from a rich and powerful family. 
Just when she encounters a lot of difficulties in her career and love life and feels helpless, she meets a military commander named Yi Yunrui, who is always on her side to support her and help her out of troubles. 
With a good-looking face, well-shaped body, rich family background and loyalty to love, Yi Yunrui is the perfect “Mr. Right” in every girl’s dream. 
The military commander claims that he has known Xia Ning for a long time, while Xia seems to know little about him. 
How does Yi Yunrui know Xia Ning? What happened between the two before the story even begins? Will Xia Ning fall in love with Yi Yunrui under his unremitting efforts? Just start reading and find out.

22696.synopsis:
An ordinary person who has passed through the Marvel World to gain the phagocyte ability and began to devour superpowers, and became the king of Marvel!

23464.synopsis:
Ren, a ten-year-old orphan, was en route to being delivered to a corrupt merchant. However, bandits attacked the carriage she was on and caused it to plummet down the sides of a cliff.

27048.synopsis:
As a God of Poverty, Cen Xi’s performance has always been very good, until……
One day, Cen Xi wakes up and finds herself in a parallel time and space as a unlucky eighteenth-tier actress and a certain big boss’ secret wife.
She goes to live in the big boss’ house. Since then, the big boss begins to suffer a reversal of fortune……
And Cen Xi discovers that her sealed powers seem to be slowly returning.
Can she go back by expending all of the big boss’ fortune?
So, Cen Xi starts to crazily spend the big boss’ money and swipe his credit card in hopes that she will soon be able to return to the God Realm.
But why is the big boss’ money increasing? And it’s increasing at a faster and faster rate?
Her powers as a God of Poverty won’t be able to suppress the big boss’ ability to increase his wealth soon!
This isn’t scientific!

27560.synopsis:
25 years ago, Gu Yuan who had a terminal disease was found to possess a rare powerful gene.
In order to allow the gene to pass through the generation, she donated out 5 ova before the failure of her surgery.
25 years later, she awakens. Her 5 ova had now turned into outstandings and famous men.
Mmmm….who is it that laughs at her for being old-fashion, backward, have nothing at all and penniless?
The world-renowned tycoon prince accompanied Gu Yuan for supper. The media was in an uproar, is the prince going to be in love?
Tycoon Prince: That’s my mother.
The media tycoon who controls the world public opinion, stake a thousand pieces of gold on one throw for Gu Yuan. The whole audience was in an uproar, an unknown girl going to marry into the noble family?
Media Tycoon: That’s my mother.
The film emperor with thousands of fans who received worldwide attention broke his 8 years practice and for the 1st time ever unexpectedly composed music for Gu Yuan. The whole internet was in an uproar, is this film emperor’s love of the century?
Film Emperor: That’s my mother.
17 years old beautiful young boy genius with IQ that beyond compares named the asteroid he found after Gu Yuan. The world was in an uproar, is this love between an older woman and a young boy?
Genius Boy: That’s my mother.
……
All the supporting males and females who had ridiculed and bullies Gu Yuan before cried: She actually has how many good sons?!
Finally, when the world’s most handsome and eligible top billionaire accompanies Gu Yuan for shopping, the crowds immediately shout loudly: She must be his mother! His mother! His mother!
The aloof top billionaire: She is the mother of my sons.

28072.synopsis: There are only two best ways to deal with problems; one was money, and the other one was power. There were no shortcuts in climbing up; even if there were, they belonged to the people who were more prepared. Fang Jie wanted to be a wealthy person during the peaceful time, but he failed at it. Then, Fang Jie wanted to live a peaceful life during the chaotic time, but he failed again.

28840.synopsis:
An encounter that brings a paleontology student together with an established actor and the romance that ensues.
Xu Zhen is a bright and optimistic young woman who doesn’t easily give up. In order to patch things up between her mother and her ailing father, she applies for a job at Jiang Ye Entertainment where her mother works as a Director and accidentally witnesses Gu Chi Jun getting coldly rejected by his ex-girlfriend yet again.
In order to protect his huge and heavily bruised ego, Gu Chi Jun does everything in his power to force Xu Zhen out so that she’ll never have a chance to expose what happened to him. She wins him over instead and becomes his personal assistant. However, Xu Zhen also learns about a conspiracy within the firm and finds that she may be in danger.

29352.synopsis:
“Uhm…..could we rent this DVD together?” Itou Daijirou, who attends an all-boys high school, visits a rental video store late one night. There, he’s “hit on” by a lone girl. From this event, the two become friends. Daijirou is having fun, but feels dissatisfied that they can only ever meet at night for a short time. Actually, he gets another weird feeling too. Mysterious phenomena happen when he’s with her, like objects that move and break without being touched. In truth, the girl – Haijima Koharu – awakened special powers when she was young. And along with other girls who also awakened their powers, she’s being kept isolated from society – an esper who lives her life in a research facility. She slips out of the facility night after night, enjoying her secret adventures in town. However, some of her classmates find out what she’s up to, and things develop from there…
A boy-meets-psychic-girl, youthful love comedy!
associated_names: Love with Her is Disturbed by PK

30632.synopsis:
Ira Waldenbiston suffered for 12 years from an unrequited love for Emperor Rubellus.
Wherever he went, she followed him like a shadow. Wanting to be the right partner for him, she held on to everything she could, but it didn’t work out. He didn’t even look at her, and all he had left was his bad reputation.
So she decided to give him up, but she found herself with a new problem.
– What are you doing here, my fiancée?
12 years of abandonment and… suddenly I’m his fiancée?
Your Majesty, I’m over it!
Ira’s unrequited love ends here!

31144.synopsis:
After transmigrating into a bankrupt supporting male lead unable to pay utility bills and blocked from finding a job anywhere, Chen Zhan decided to… get rich writing an autobiography!
Recalling the life of the vicious supporting male lead, he wrote a trilogy of his life, 《Confessions: The Birth and Death of a Rebellious Youth’s Emotions》,  《The Years When I Harassed the Queen of Film》, 《The Egg that Tried to Crush the Stone: Hatred for the Rich Led Me to Repeatedly Slander the Rich CEO》….
Among them, 《Confessions》caused an uproar as soon as it was published.

Female Lead: He’s just looking for attention.
Male Lead: If the heavens want him to die, they must first make him (Chen Zhan) crazy.
Passerbys A, B, C: Rubbish novels, whoever reads them is s*upid!
Then-
They all secretly became Chen Zhan’s readers.
Later, “Confessions” was completed, and the netizens: His talent was exhausted and this was just a temporary win.
The next day, it was revealed that Chen Zhan had captured the most mysterious and wealthy upstart in Y City.
Chen Zhan: Please support my new book: 《The Years When the Male God Chased Me》.
Netizens: …You won!!!
In short: Not after money, nor a house.
Theme: Even in difficult situations, success is possible through hard work.

34216.synopsis:
The day before her marriage, she witnessed her boyfriend and his prospective sister-in-law perform restricted drama in the office. When her heart was broken, a calm man appeared beside her.
“Marry me, so that their two shameless men and women will call you sister-in-law every day? How?”
In this way, got the certificate.
However, who would have thought that the husband who was originally in a wheelchair is not only incompetent, but also eats her up at every turn…

35240.synopsis: “You, come here for a hug.” “I’m sorry, Your Highness, but you can’t hug me as you like.” She holds a fresh-faced young man with her left hand and a lady killer with her right hand. How could she let him have her so easily? Let’s see how the domineering and bossy prince wins the heart of this sassy girl with the unparalleled beauty.

38056.synopsis:
“From today onwards, the sinner’s statuses will be stripped, and his female ward will live as a low-leveled maid at the Royal Palace.”
Stellen Kingdom, Ayla Serdian who was the daughter of the most reputed Count.
Because of her father’s embezzlement of a national treasure, she lost her noble status overnight and became a maid at the royal palace.
A man approaches her. Theon Ennedi, the grandson of the King of the Stellen Kingdom.
“If you ever eavesdrop again on the royal family, you won’t come out unscathed.”
He, who was cold at first, says something unexpected.
“If you tell me to stop… I won’t push it.”
Soon the distance between them slowly shrunk, enough for their lips to touch. The light mint scent coining from him tickled Ayla’s nose. As Theon’s unusually rough breath caressed her forehead, her whole body tensed up, holding her gasp.
“I wish you would look at me.”
“…”
“If you don’t like it, I will stop.”
Her reason was telling her to refuse him. But under the control of Theon’s voice, asking for her permission as if taming her, the words hardly came out. “I do not… hate it.”

39592.synopsis: Lu Liangwei wakes up to find herself transmigrated as a supporting character in the novel she had been reading a few days ago. According to the novel, this character has everything—beauty, wealth, status—except brains. Before Liangwei had taken over, she even went as far as to hang herself for the male protagonist that she loved: the Crown Prince as well as her sister’s lover. Now that she has become a “brand new” person, it is time for her to turn her life around with charm and wit! She will get everyone to fall in love with her, even the Crown Prince’s uncle—the Emperor! Who needs a prince when you can become the Empress herself?

39848.synopsis: The story of a mild noble who slipped from one fantasy world into another. While he had no particular blessings in this other world, there was also no particular crisis. Izak, on whom I had a passionate crush, has become my husband. 
This wonderful situation made me realise that I’ve given birth to twins! 
I thought it was a happy situation… but why are we now in the middle of a divorce? Divorce before I can even enjoy my marriage.
I don’t even remember how the twins were made. 
Estella, facing a divorce crisis, tries everything she can to soften Izak’s cold heart…! 
“Papa and Mama, kiss.” 
“Mama likes Papa, don’t you like her?”
A pair of adorable twins who fancy themselves Cupids.

“I thought it was a body conversation.”
I’m trying to communicate with my once-affectionate, now cold-hearted husband. 
“This man is supposed to love me anyway.”
The seven-year time-skip marriage of Estella, the beloved princess of the Messiah Kingdom, whose unfounded confidence knows no bounds.

41128.synopsis:
Wen Qiao is a delicate-looking but secretly fierce “queen flower.” Anyone who dares to defy her can expect to be beaten into submission.  
She has a seemingly useless husband who cannot cultivate, but Wen Qiao doesn’t mind. She decides that the two of them will live this life well together.  
Later, she discovers that her “useless” husband, who cannot cultivate in the eyes of the world, is actually a genius proficient in alchemy, talismans, forging, and arrays. Not only that, he can accompany her on the path of cultivation, and the two of them set out together on a journey to ascend to godhood.  
However, halfway through their journey, someone suddenly tells her that her husband is actually the reincarnation of the Demon Lord who once sought to destroy the world. His virtuous and gentlemanly demeanor is just a façade to deceive everyone, and he might secretly be planning to destroy the world all over again.

As a beauty recognized within her social circles, Ye An was fair and pretty with a slender waist and slim legs. It was a pity that she had married a blind man.

After marriage, Ye An lived as freely as she wanted. Living in his mansion, spending his money, and running amok right in front of him.

Liana became Duke Pruis’s bedroom companion because of the debt of a biological father she had never seen.
Meanwhile, Dain, a duke of the Mancus Empire and king of the snake clan, contracted a disease where pheromones accumulated. He would be in mortal danger if he couldn’t relieve his pheromones by spending nights with women, yet he couldn’t complete interc**rse with women to the end. His stress reached its peak from this, and he headed to the bedroom where she was, planning to kill Baron Brian’s daughter if she couldn’t satisfy him.
* * *
Liana’s hand groped Dain’s chest and stomach, gradually moving downward. Dain didn’t stop her. Soon his secret would be exposed.
When she found out, she might run away.
She might despise him, calling him disgusting.

He caressed her chest with a nervous heart.

After a moment, Liana’s body froze. Below Dain’s solid muscular lower abdomen, something the size of a child’s forearm was rising.

A shocked expression appeared on Liana’s face.

130984.synopsis:
Liandan’s husband had died before he even married into the Chen family.
What he married was a memorial tablet.
Liandan was forced to sleep every night holding that cold memorial tablet. After a long time, his warm body even made the tablet turn warm.
***
At the east end of Kaoshan Village, there was a temple, very effective for praying for children.
The Chen family’s old woman wanted Liandan to give her a grandson, so she sent him to stay at that monk temple for a few days to pray for blessings.
When Liandan went to burn incense in the temple, he overheard the head monk telling the old woman that his dead husband could return at night to consummate the marriage with him.
He was scared to death and naturally did not want to go.
But the old woman beat him half to death. Asking his parents for help did not work either.
Liandan had no one to rely on, so he had no choice but to go.
On the night he moved into the temple, in complete darkness, Liandan’s face turned pale when he saw the door that had been locked push open. A white shadow floated in front of him, the smell of blood and rot rushing toward him.
Liandan’s eyes filled with tears from fear. His lips trembled open but no sound came out. He only mouthed the words: “Husband.”
The white shadow lowered its head and looked at him for a while. Fingers cold like dried bones touched Liandan’s fragile neck and tore open his clothes.
That night, Liandan clenched his teeth and endured it.
A month later, Liandan was indeed pregnant.
The old woman of the Chen family was overjoyed. She treated him especially well, no longer beat or scolded him, and even made him good food.
But Liandan himself was not happy at all. Instead, he was fearful all day and anxious.
Only he knew that his husband had already turned into a vicious ghost.
That night, the temple had been full of blood and severed limbs, like hell itself.
The monks had been slaughtered like livestock, none left alive.
After he gave birth to a big fat grandson, the old woman of the Chen family was overjoyed. When she went out to show off, she tripped on the threshold and fell, bedridden and unable to get up.
A doctor passing through the village came to take a look and prescribed some medicine.
Liandan asked when his mother-in-law would get better. That young doctor, who had a delicate face but a tall build, stared at him with eagle-like eyes for a long time. After Liandan started to feel uneasy, the doctor shifted his gaze to the baby in Liandan’s arms, stared with unusual focus, and spoke coldly and slowly: “She will not get better.”
The next day, the old woman’s son came back to life and returned home.

137896.synopsis:

One day, as he glances at the living room table, he realizes that Yuri has forgotten her trusty pouch, the one she always uses during her streams.

Still wearing his apron, Sōta rushes to deliver the forgotten item all the way to the dungeon… only to accidentally appear on Yuri’s livestream!
“Souta-nii!? What are you doing here!?”
And just like that, the ordinary salaryman who never meant to stand out suddenly goes viral, marking the start of his wild, chaotic life as a dungeon streamer!

149416.synopsis:
Gyo Yeon-oh, the youngest son of the Gyo General’s Household, one day met a man of exquisite appearance who visited his home.
Contrary to his first impression, Yeon-oh gradually grew closer to the man, who possessed an unexpected vulnerability.
It was then that Yeon-oh discovered this man was none other than the current Emperor, who had ascended the throne after mu*dering his own kin.
The Emperor had come to the Gyo General’s Household to take a concubine from the Gyo Marquisate family.
Yeon-oh felt a strange emotion at the thought that one of his female cousins would become the man’s concubine.
However, the Emperor sought out Yeon-oh, presented him with a token, and requested that he become his concubine.
******
A firm hand clasped Yeon-oh’s.
“I wish for you.”
The man turned Yeon-oh’s held hand, revealing his palm. An identity tablet bearing a phoenix crest, crafted from ox horn, was placed on the exposed palm. Carefully folding Yeon-oh’s fingers so the ox horn phoenix tablet would not drop, the man smiled softly.
“What…?”
Yeon-oh blinked, bewildered by the situation. Was what he was seeing now reality, or a dream?
“I wish for you to become my person, Yeon-oh.”
******
Yeon-oh became the Emperor’s concubine, believing it to be love. However, it did not take long for him to realize that his first affection was a lie.
The Emperor had a true paramour. Moreover, he had countless other concubines. The Dowager Empress, whom Yeon-oh had believed would be his ally as a relative, even seized his people and persecuted them, making life as a concubine arduous.
It was amidst this hardship that he discovered the reason for his entrance into the palace was merely to facilitate the easy entrance of the Emperor’s true paramour. Yeon-oh realized that he was nothing more than an obstruction, a villain placed between their two loves.
******
“Why, why was it me of all people? Your Majesty could not have been unaware that the Dowager Empress desired a Gyo Marquisate family member to secure the imperial line…”
Yeon-oh suspected that the Emperor’s cold shoulder might have been predetermined from the moment he first appeared at the Gyo General’s Household. Yet, a part of his heart hoped desperately that this was not true. He hoped the interest, which had reached out to him so quickly, had merely cooled down just as fast.
The Emperor stepped closer to Yeon-oh. As the tall man approached, a shadow fell over Yeon-oh’s face, which was stained with shock. Yeon-oh, who had been meticulously observing the rules of etiquette, even forgot the courtly bows ingrained in his body.
“Yeon-oh.”
A bright smile dawned on the man’s noble face. That same smile—which Yeon-oh had seen when he believed they were becoming intimate—possessed the power to seize a person’s gaze.
“…”
Yeon-oh accepted the truth: he had been truly deceived by the affectionate low tone calling his name. His foolish heart fluttered at the fabricated, familiar address made by the man.
“It would have been better had you been dull and lacking. Wouldn’t everyone be more comfortable had you grasped your predicament, despaired, diminished your presence, and resigned yourself to the back quarters?”
Yeon-oh’s shoulders rose and fell sharply at the man’s soft murmur. The smooth words, disguised as tenderness, were as warm as the spring breeze. Yeon-oh found his own feelings—the longing he felt for this pretense of familiarity, the regret that surfaced from the feigned intimacy—to be pathetic and sorrowful.

172712.synopsis:
For over twenty years, the desolate northern pastoral areas have finally welcomed their first priest. Rumor has it that he can directly see the hidden sins of those who confess.
Introduction: Shu Li was a university student majoring in psychology before being reincarnated. After transmigrating into a Western Fantasy novel of political intrigue and revenge, he was dispatched by the Bishop to a remote, impoverished town to proselytize because he was poor and lacked connections.
Almost no one in the small town believed in religion, and life was very tight. After going two consecutive days without food, he began to use his professional knowledge to “market” himself. In an area with low social mobility and a close-knit community, it is actually very easy to create the illusion of “mind reading.” Furthermore, the Church has always loved to monopolize the concept of “insight into the human heart” as a divine right.
Thus, Shu Li inexplicably became the “Incarnation of God.” Regardless, his life didn’t change much; he just spent his days listening to prayers and occasionally “eating melon” (enjoying gossip). That is, until one day, the sound of a young boy’s sobbing emerged.
“Lord God, if You truly exist, please, I beg You to save me.”
Shu Li discovered that the future protagonist of the novel—the child of a Duke—was currently being ab*sed. After a brief headache, Shu Li spoke:
“Listen, I know the biggest secret of the servant who locks your door. You can make him obey you.”
Leslie, the Duke’s son and the future supreme monarch of the entire continent’s empire, once endured cruel, cold, helpless, and dark days during his childhood. It wasn’t until the day he first prayed to God that a voice rang out: “Listen, I know the biggest secret of the servant who locks your door. You can make him obey you.”
That voice seemed to light up his entire world.
Years later, he ascended to the pinnacle of the continent and built the most luxurious temple to serve his God. The Pope had never seen such a devout monarch and allowed him to freely enter and exit the main hall to stay alone with the Incarnation of God. The Emperor held the other’s hand, fervently kissing the back of the hand of the Divine Incarnation.
“Lord God, please grant me one more request.”
